# ASN.1 (ISO/PAS 15118-202) ESDP / ENP codec — how to reproduce

The EvseV2G module's ESDP/ENP support uses C code generated by `asn1c` from the
ISO/PAS 15118-202:2025 ASN.1 schemas. **The `.asn` files and everything generated
from them are not committed** (they are gitignored). You must create them once
after cloning, **before running CMake**; configuration stops with an error
otherwise.

## Source schemas

| File | Download from |
|------|---------------|
| `esdp_extensions.asn` | https://standards.iso.org/iso/pas/15118/-202/ed-1/en/ESDPExtensions.asn |
| `enp_extensions.asn`  | https://standards.iso.org/iso/pas/15118/-202/ed-1/en/ENPExtensions.asn |

The published files contain a transcription defect (`EXTENSION.` and `&id` split
across lines) that every ASN.1 compiler rejects. `fetch_asn1.sh` downloads them,
keeps the untouched originals as `*.asn.orig`, and rejoins only those line breaks.
Details: `UPSTREAM_NOTE.md`.

## Steps (from the repository root)

Requirements: Docker (both scripts run in an `ubuntu:24.04` container), network
access, `bash`.

```bash
# 1. Download + normalize the schemas
#    -> lib/3rd_party/asn1/esdp_extensions.asn, enp_extensions.asn (+ .orig)
ASN1_OUTPUT_UID="$(id -u)" ASN1_OUTPUT_GID="$(id -g)" ./lib/3rd_party/asn1/fetch_asn1.sh
#    (without Docker: ./lib/3rd_party/asn1/fetch_asn1.sh --host   # needs curl + perl)

# 2. Build asn1c (vlm/asn1c, master) in a container, derive asn1c-compatible
#    schemas, and generate the C codec
#    -> *.c, *.h, all_asn1c_headers.h, CMakeLists.txt, Makefile.am.libasncodec
./lib/3rd_party/asn1/regenerate_asn1c.sh

# 3. Build EVerest as usual (cmake configure picks up lib/3rd_party/asn1)
```

`regenerate_asn1c.sh` replaces the `EXTENSION` information-object class with plain
`OCTET STRING (SIZE (16))` / `OCTET STRING` fields (asn1c cannot generate the
open-type dispatch); `esdp.cpp` dispatches on the 16-byte UUID itself. It runs
`asn1c -no-gen-example -fcompound-names`, and the committed code was built against
output stamped `asn1c-0.9.29`. Because the script clones asn1c `master`, pin a
commit in the script if you need bit-for-bit repeatable output.

## Optional: golden test vectors

`pycrate_spike.sh` (Docker) uses pycrate to encode reference OER fixtures into
`fixtures_pycrate/{esdp,enp}/`. It needs step 1 first and is not required to build.

## Python EVCC counterpart

The Josev fork (`ext-switchev-iso15118`) also part of this github repo in a separate folder generates its own schema from the same
ISO file with `iso15118/evcc/asn1/generate_esdp_definitions.sh`; see its README.
